"The Pentagon said on Sunday that a third member of the American military had died during a weekend of intense exchanges of attacks with Iran, as the war escalated and the United States began sending more warplanes to the Middle East.

The soldier was killed in northern Iraq during the disposal of a downed Iranian attack drone on Saturday, the Pentagon said.
